Hi 👋 and welcome to my notes as ML Liaison for the United Weather Centers
(UWC*)!

My aim for this website is to use it to document my work in the UWC ML Liaison role,
principally in the form of [blog posts](posts.qmd), and create pages that help coordinate my work across the meteorological community.

I am writing this site because I have always enjoyed reading technical blogs
myself, and I thought having a website would help me communicate and organise
different projects I am undertaking in my ML Liaison role.

If you are interested in more background about the ML Liaison role itself and what I am to do with it
[please check out my first blog post](posts/2026-06-09-introducing-uwc-ml-liaison-role/index.qmd).

> *: the UWC is comprised of the meteorological services of [DMI](https://dmi.dk),
[ESTEA](https://www.envir.ee/en), [FMI](https://en.ilmatieteenlaitos.fi),
[IMO](https://en.vedur.is), [Met Éireann](https://www.met.ie),
[LEGMC](https://www.meteo.lv), [LHMS](https://www.meteo.lt),
[KNMI](https://www.knmi.nl), [MET Norway](https://www.met.no),
[AEMET](https://www.aemet.es) and [SMHI](https://www.smhi.se)
